# Vendored dependencies

`jspdf.umd.min.js` — [jsPDF](https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF) 2.5.2, MIT
licensed, fetched from
<https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@2.5.2/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js>.

It is committed on purpose: the Pages site generates PDFs entirely in the
browser, with no CDN call and no network needed once the page has loaded.
The full license notice is preserved in the file header.
